★ Request
Costume: Tracksuit (Summer) kept as is. *Image is after training, coming straight to the festival,
and having eaten food from the food stalls.

Eeeh?! Why did you go quiet?!
How was the time on that last lap?!

Trainer, if there's anything you want to eat, just let me know, okay?
I'll sprint over and buy it!

To reward Haru Urara for giving it her all at the training camp and to replenish her energy,
we came out to have fun at a nearby summer festival.

Yeah! After doing all this, I've gotta be faster now!
Right, Trainer?!

Huuuh... Hey, Trainer!
Can I do just one more lap?
I'm so, so glad you became my Trainer after all!
Hup! Hup! Hup!

Aww, man! Too bad...!
Then this next one is definitely, absolutely the final lap!

Ah.
...Ehehe! My tummy's hungry!

I'd love to stay and watch longer, but I have my next assignment, so I must take my leave.
I'll send the photos over as digital data later!

Taking a breather from training camp, Urara-chan?
How are you holding up?
I just wanted to do one more run before heading back!

Oh, you came to have fun too, mister!
!
Time me, please, Trainer!
Hup, hup, hup, hup!
(Grrrrrr...)

Yeah! I'm definitely taking 1st place next time,
so make sure to come cheer for me again!

Hup! Hup!
...Nnnngoooooal!

I told Haru Urara that if she kept this up,
her times would definitely start dropping.

Since I worked so hard, I really want
to finish summer camp knowing I got faster!

That's a picture of me!
What about it?

Haru Urara shouts toward the sea.
In her own way, she must be frustrated about not seeing results.

Urara-san is full of energy today, too.
Shining even brighter than the seaside sun!
Really? Am I really getting better at running!?

Whoa! Nobody's ever told me my running looks pretty before!
Wh-What do you mean?

I believe you! I really, really believe you!
I get it now! I'm improving!

Yeah, feeling good!
Alright, one more lap!
Umm, well... I ran a lot and had tons of fun!

Ready whenever you are!
Give me the signal!!

I show Haru Urara the two photos the reporter sent me.
One from when they first met, and one from today.

I always thought I could get 1st place, but now,
I really, really, REALLY know I can do it!

Ehehehe♪ Ah! Hey, look over there!
They have ring toss, so nostalgic!

Once we're back at the academy, I'll try even, even, EEEVEN harder,
get super fast, and definitely take 1st place!

Ehehe♪ Festivals are so much fun!
Trainer, thank you for bringing me!

The final practice day of Tracen Academy's summer training camp.
Haru Urara threw herself into training at full throttle today, as always.
Haru Urara took her spot at the starting line looking unusually serious.

She hasn't noticed it herself, but her training is definitely paying off.
To show her the proof, I take out my smartphone.

The reporter—a fan of Haru Urara visiting to cover the camp—
snaps photos of her as she runs.

The difference between the two photos is her running form.
She has undeniably developed a far more efficient stride.
Urara-chan?

Uwaaaaaaah!
I didn't beat my record!

I see, glad to hear it!
I'll be looking forward to your races after summer camp.

Alright, I'm gonna do my best even back at the academy!
Keep taking care of me, okay, Trainer!

Goooal!
*pant* *pant*... What's my time!?
After parting ways with the familiar man—

Training went on all day long.
And then—

Granting Haru Urara's request,
I came out to the beach at night.

*phew*... *phew*...
I'm soo tiiired! But I gave it everything I got!

Mmm, festival food is so yummy!
Crepes, sponge cake, and carrot candy♪
